did.unittitle: Coby Foundation records

physdesc.extent: 39 containers: 37 letter document boxes, 1 legal document box, 1 oversize box

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research with select materials restricted as noted. RAC provides an access surrogate of digital media and born-digital files, not the original files. To request an access surrogate be made, please contact a RAC archivist.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection documents the Coby Foundation's history, operations, and grantmaking, with a focus on its support for textile and needle arts-related exhibitions in the Mid-Atlantic and New England. It also includes correspondence, administrative records, and materials related to the estate of Irene Zambelli Silverman, who created the foundation.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The collection is arranged into four series: Administrative Files, Ward Mintz Files, Grants, and the Irene Silverman Estate.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Coby Foundation has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: This collection was donated to RAC by the Coby Foundation in 2025.

did.unittitle: Administrative Files

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series documents the establishment, governance, and ongoing administrative operations of the Coby Foundation. Materials include bylaws, mission statement, early planning notes, and correspondence related to the organization's formation (including the correspondence of Rosemarie Garipoli, John Sare, and Ward Mintz). Board meeting materials from 2000-2024 form a substantial portion of this series.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Records 10 years old or older are open for research with select materials restricted as noted.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series is made up of correspondence received by Executive Director, Ward Mintz, from institutions funded by or connected to the Coby Foundation. The files document grant‑funded project updates, final reports, and professional relationships with museums, artists, and cultural organizations. The series provides insight into Mintz's role in shaping the foundation's grantmaking priorities and maintaining relationships with grantees.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series documents the Coby Foundation's grantmaking activities. Files include proposals, correspondence, budgets, reports, exhibition documentation, and supporting materials from museums, cultural organizations, and academic institutions. The grants primarily support textile‑related exhibitions, conservation projects, and publications. Rejected proposals and miscellaneous grant files appear at the end of the series.

did.unittitle: Irene Silverman Estate

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series contains material about Irene Zambelli Silverman, her estate, and her role in establishing the Coby Foundation. Records include correspondence, photographs, ephemera, and materials documenting Silverman's personal life, artistic interests, and property. Notable items include photographs of Silverman, materials related to the "Nagata collection," and documentation of the Chagall Bible volume associated with her estate.
